verdicts.reason: A shrinks the 'Longest Day Sale' banner to an illegible sliver and strands it in the bottom-right, losing the key brand device. It promotes the legal fine print to near-subhead size above the CTA. The headline block sits over the large background circle, and the bottom third is dead space. B keeps the banner prominent and the hierarchy clear, with a big headline and CTA. But the logo is pushed off-centre to the right and collides visually with the banner row. The left-aligned text block clashes with the centred CTA and product. The fine print is also oversized, and the lower half is cramped while the top is airy.
